title: Arrowvale Campground & Cottages

services.name: Farm Tours
services.desc: Ann & Bob Collins have farmed in the Valley since 1980. Their 67 acre property along the Somass River is blessed with fertile soil and ample water. For the past 16 years they have grown all their fruits and vegetables without the use of pesticides, herbicides or chemical fertilizers. Two Canadian Horses and one mustang, our herd of Belted Galloway Cattle as well as chickens, goats, donkeys and pigs and barn cats call this place home. blurb: Set along the tranquil Somass River, Arrowvale Campground offers scenic riverside campsites and two beautifully crafted cedar cottages surrounded by the natural beauty of the Alberni Valley. Alongside the campground, guests can experience the charm of Collins Farm, featuring grass-fed beef, local polyfloral honey, seasonal pumpkins and produce.
